note: THE CANONICAL CHAT-HITL CAPTURE INDEX. One committed index and one shared recorder (scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-recorder.mjs) replace ad-hoc capture scripts, so a screenshot is never the only evidence. Every record carries the cell, the host it DECLARES, the URL the page actually ended on, the screenshot path with its sha256, and the frame-scoped selector assertions with the counts that were observed. The gate (scripts/audit/chat-hitl-acceptance-gate.mjs) validates schema, hashes, URL class, the required host anchors and their successful counts. FILE NAMES CARRY NO AUTHORITY: a cell called `__chat_thread__` whose record ended on a run-detail URL, or whose chat anchors were never asserted, is a mislabeled capture and fails — which is the exact defect this index was built after. A record may also assert an anchor ABSENT (expect: "absent", count 0); that is how a placeholder shell is proven to be a placeholder. RECORDS ARE EMPTY BY DESIGN here: the canonical AC-15 cell names, the capture set and the manifest READY transition belong to the conformance re-capture slice, and adopting an earlier round's capture without re-validating it against this harness is the thing the index exists to prevent. The validator is proven by its fixtures, not by the size of this list.
